title: Moro'gai tribe
wikitext:
The '''Moro'gai tribe''' is a tribe of [[Draenei]] from across the Dark Portal that has made a new home in the [[Moonwhisper Coast]].

==Notes and trivia==
* The Moro'gai were originally an unused faction of draenei that existed in the ''World of Warcraft'' beta but was never implemented into the game.
* Their original description stated that they were a "faction of Draenei from across the Dark Portal is trying to make a new home in the [[Swamps of Sorrow]] while beset by strife and the madness of their kin". Presumably, this depiction was made defunct, as the two draenei tribes that live in the Swamp of Sorrows are the [[Tribe of Sanv]] and the [[Lost Ones]].
* Although the faction had originally been announced as the '''Moro'gai''' in the notes for [[patch 1.16.0]], no content was ever developed for them and no NPCs were ever attributed to the faction. The tribe itself would later be added in [[patch 1.18.1]] in the [[Moonwhisper Coast]] as part of the [[Draenei Exiles]] faction.

==Patch changes==
* {{Patch|1.16.0|note="Added" as a reputation faction.}}
